# Vendored browser libraries

## canvas-confetti

- Version: 1.9.3
- Source: https://github.com/catdad/canvas-confetti
- License: ISC (see `canvas-confetti.LICENSE`)
- File: `confetti.browser.js` (official browser build from the npm package)

Used for large-gift fireworks, confetti, rose rain, hearts and sparkles.
If the file is missing, `static/gift-effects.js` falls back to its CSS effects.
